name: East China Engineering Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: East China Engineering Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is an engineering firm primarily operating within the People's Republic of China. This company undertakes a diverse array of projects, encompassing key sectors such as coal chemicals, organic and inorganic chemicals, basic chemical raw materials, and coatings. Its expertise also extends to various fertilizer production processes, including nitrogenous, phosphate compound, and potassium fertilizers, as well as crucial energy initiatives like coal-to-methanol conversion, liquefied natural gas (LNG), thermal and wind power generation, and urban gas infrastructure. Furthermore, the company is involved in water management solutions, specifically organic wastewater treatment and water supply, alongside broader environmental protection efforts. The services provided by the company are comprehensive, ranging from initial consulting and detailed engineering design to procurement, construction, and full project management. While its primary operations are rooted in China, East China Engineering Science and Technology Co., Ltd. boasts an international footprint, with engagements in countries including the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Pakistan, Iran, Chile, Indonesia, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, Iraq, South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Tunisia, and the Republic of Congo, among others. Established in 1963, the company maintains its main office in Hefei, People's Republic of China, and functions as a subsidiary of East China Engineering Corporation.
